title: Korean War Begins
description:
On June 25, 1950, North Korean forces invaded South Korea, beginning the **Korean War**.

The conflict drew in international forces, with the United States and allies supporting South Korea under UN command, while China and the Soviet Union backed North Korea.

The war ended in an armistice on July 27, 1953, but no peace treaty was ever signed. Korea remains divided along the 38th parallel to this day.
